Website check: Same Marriott page also says the ballroom has 'space for 120' and the outdoor garden plaza 'can host up to 200 guests' (wedding wording), versus 300 in its FAQ. Treat 300 as the room maximum and 200 as the wedding figure.
Website check: elmangroovehotel.com home page shows no address or event info; event facts come from the Marriott brand page.
Website check: Record city 'Golfo de Papagayo (Guanacaste)' is fine; OpenStreetMap places the hotel at Playa Panamá, Sardinal, Carrillo (coordinates from Nominatim 'El Mangroove Hotel, Vía 159').
Outdoor music must be completely off at 10:00 pm; to go later the party moves to a meeting room with extra set-up, service and bar charges (this is the 'moving inside' we asked about)
Celebrating Love package (20 to 200 guests): $6,400 for 20, $11,050 for 40, $15,700 for 60, $24,900 for 100; drinks extra
Celebrating Love includes room upgrade for couple and parents, symbolic ceremony, bouquet, cake, centerpieces, acoustic ceremony music, 1 hour appetizers and a private plated dinner
The Perfect Forever package (20 to 200 guests): $12,100 for 20, $18,600 for 40, $25,100 for 60, $38,100 for 100
Perfect Forever adds plated or buffet dinner, champagne toast, 1-hour deluxe open bar for cocktail hour, 3 appetizers per person and a DJ for 4 hours
Evening outdoor events need basic lighting, priced separately; prices may change on holidays
Hotel has 121 rooms (suites), 42 of them connecting; plus 2-, 3- and 4-bedroom residential villas
Largest spaces: Beach Forest outdoor 250 banquet / 300 reception; Garden Plaza 200 banquet / 250 reception; Ocean Terrace 150 banquet / 200 reception
Closest beachfront resort to Liberia International Airport, about 20 minutes
Resort fee includes kayaks, bicycles, valet parking, internet, yoga and spa relaxation area
Plated dinner is capped at 100 people; stations need 20 guests minimum, buffets 30
Menu prices exclude 13% sales tax and 10% service; live chef $150 + tax
Plated 3-course dinners $53 (From the Bay) or $62 per person; Sea and Land $62
Buffets per person (min 30): Mexican Party $87, Mexican $95, Seafood $85, Mediterranean $81, BBQ $58, El Manglar $62, El Mangroove $85, Tico $85
Stations per person: Executive $41, Burger $38, Mangiare $51, La Vasta Pasta $51, Taco $52, Farm $58, From the Sea $60, Grill $62, Mediterranean $69, Carving $73, dessert $31
Canapes $7 to $8 per piece (premium $6 to $10), choose 3 per person
Kids menu $8 to $9 per plate
Deluxe open bar per guest: $48 1 hour, $64 2 hours, $74 3 hours, $91 4 hours, $96 5 hours (2026)
Premium open bar per guest: $59 1 hour to $128 for 5 hours (2026)
Soft bar (mocktails) per guest: $22 1 hour to $53 for 4 hours
Bar: add 13% tax and 10% service, minimum 12 guests, full hours only; bar set-up fee $150 for 2 hours plus $50 per extra hour
Corkage allowed: $28 per bottle plus $350 set-up, and a mixers bar must be bought ($30 1 hour to $40 3 hours)
Sales Companion lists 4 meeting rooms, 3 outdoor event venues, 3 restaurants, 2 bars and offers Indian wedding events (Mehendi, Sangeet)
Wedding package contact is Jasson Masis, Weddings and Social Events Key Account Manager
